title: Structured native interactions
donor_paths: Frozen 154-path inventory: task00 tasks.json id 07 (PR647, evidence 7ac9b4ac); implemented slice is the 8 exclusive paths plus selected OMP-core/fixture/doc hunks listed in the PR description.
implementation: Typed question/approval fields on the existing permission wire (secret, initialValue, allowEmpty, dismissBehavior, preserveWhitespace; confirm detail without raw tool JSON); OMP adapter interprets native frames, UI never parses OMP strings. New omp/bootstrap.rs provisional session publishes startup dialogs before native initialization completes and answers them through the same serialized writer; first input queued once and released through the same native session, cancelled input never replayed. Metadata probes run --no-ui while still loading plugins. No new RPC methods, events, providerUi state or generic native_action gateway; later consumers own their own typed schemas.
acceptance: Real structured forms preserve all value/cancel semantics; reconnect and startup recover drafts without repeating side effects; approvals are not blocked by command waits and secrets are not leaked.
compatibility: No public SDK/UI/protocol envelope changes: AgentPermissionRequestPayloadSchema.input stays an open record and only optional question fields are added; permission events, pendingPermissions snapshot and agent.permission.resolve.request unchanged; no method registration or capability-count changes. Old clients keep rendering/answering the same permission requests; new clients on old hosts simply never see the optional fields. Internal Rust changes: session::open gains a startup sender parameter (bridge/tests updated), OmpClient create/resume signatures unchanged. ACP structure untouched (task01).

required: affected fmt/clippy/build/tests and runtime smoke for changed backend
affected SDK/UI/protocol checks and documented old-host/client downgrade
